description: Record replay fixtures for newly supported Google lanes and add sparse live verifier coverage for high-signal Google-native features.

comments.text: Recorded replay fixtures for Google text/object/embed/image lanes, added sparse Google live verifier coverage, and hardened Imagen image requests to reject unsupported :size overrides before provider execution. Live Google text/object/embed/Gemini image checks passed with real API key; Imagen passed live without :size and now fails fast locally when :size is supplied.

title: Add Google fixtures and live verifiers
